subject: math
description: Transform a circle equation from general form to center-radius form by completing the square, then identify the center and radius.
learningObjectives: Recognize the general form of a circle equation
Group x-terms and y-terms before completing the square
Add the correct square-completion constants to both sides
Rewrite perfect-square trinomials as binomial squares
Identify the center and radius from center-radius form
prerequisites: Graphing points on the coordinate plane
